name: Paper Press
brief:
Aesthetic: warm paper (cream ground, serif headlines, one orange accent)
Vocabulary: light print screen over the photo, warm paper ground, registration marks, mono data callouts, dashed grid rules, single orange accent
Reference feel: Stillpage, SPADE
House DNA: One real photograph anchors the page; Technical marginalia; Type at extremes; Near-monochrome ground + single warm accent (orange, amber, terracotta, red)
Never: Purple gradients, Glossy 3D SaaS blobs, Rounded-everything friendliness, Icon-grid feature rows, Inter/system-font-only typography, Evenly-distributed colorful palettes
One risk: Let the hero photo run full-bleed and set the copy on a paper panel at its foot
heroTreatment: Full-bleed trade photo warmed toward the paper under a light print screen (overlay at most 0.55); copy sits on a cream panel at the foot; pill nav floats on top, black pill CTA.

name: Ink Split
brief:
Aesthetic: ink mono (brutalist black and white)
Vocabulary: stark black and white, film grain, serif display, split-screen copy + photo, giant cropped wordmark, high contrast
Reference feel: MONOLITH, Castle
House DNA: One real photograph anchors the page; Technical marginalia; Type at extremes; Near-monochrome ground + single warm accent (orange, amber, terracotta, red)
Never: Purple gradients, Glossy 3D SaaS blobs, Rounded-everything friendliness, Icon-grid feature rows, Inter/system-font-only typography, Evenly-distributed colorful palettes
One risk: Push the hero photo to black and white and let a cropped wordmark run off the viewport
heroTreatment: Two-field split: left white column with a huge serif headline and black CTA block, right field a black-and-white trade photo under a light dot screen (overlay at most 0.55), cropped hard at the split.

name: Dusk Horizon
brief:
Aesthetic: vast quiet cinematic (minimal x cinematic)
Vocabulary: monumental photography, dusk color grade, tiny centered sans, extreme negative space, quiet CTA
Reference feel: CTGT (hero), CTGT (alt hero)
House DNA: One real photograph anchors the page; Technical marginalia; Type at extremes; Near-monochrome ground + single warm accent (orange, amber, terracotta, red)
Never: Purple gradients, Glossy 3D SaaS blobs, Rounded-everything friendliness, Icon-grid feature rows, Inter/system-font-only typography, Evenly-distributed colorful palettes
One risk: Let the photo occupy the whole viewport and keep the headline quiet
heroTreatment: Full-bleed trade photo graded toward teal dusk (overlay at most 0.55); headline top-left on the darkened sky; orange CTA; mono scroll cue and a service ticker run along the bottom edge.

name: Classic Light
brief:
Aesthetic: classic remix (traditional x soft-futurism)
Vocabulary: serif headlines, soft sky palette, gold accents, canvas grain, orbit-line overlay, rounded glass input
Reference feel: Juris, Break the Pattern
House DNA: One real photograph anchors the page; Technical marginalia; Type at extremes; Near-monochrome ground + single warm accent (orange, amber, terracotta, red)
Never: Purple gradients, Glossy 3D SaaS blobs, Rounded-everything friendliness, Icon-grid feature rows, Inter/system-font-only typography, Evenly-distributed colorful palettes
One risk: Put the trade photo in a tall framed panel beside the headline and let the orbit lines run behind both
heroTreatment: Right-half trade photo in a tall panel with light canvas grain on white; faint orbit lines continue behind the left text column; plain serif headline; blue pill CTA; trust strip below.

name: Warm Story
brief:
Aesthetic: warm and friendly (playful x cinematic)
Vocabulary: chunky display wordmark, type-masked wordmark, saturated but graded palette, split photo panel
Reference feel: MARBLE, Vitra
House DNA: One real photograph anchors the page; Technical marginalia; Type at extremes; Near-monochrome ground + single warm accent (orange, amber, terracotta, red)
Never: Purple gradients, Glossy 3D SaaS blobs, Rounded-everything friendliness, Icon-grid feature rows, Inter/system-font-only typography, Evenly-distributed colorful palettes
One risk: Mask the entire brand wordmark in a warm gradient so the letters glow against the green
heroTreatment: Split layout: left flat pale panel with a deep-green chunky display headline and CTA, right vertical trade photo panel with light paper tooth, cropped at the panel edge.
